divisions.headline: Jonesing drops Appetite again with a scorching 37-dart 1001 to take even more control of A race; Beach takes all sets from Darty in big step toward locking in top-4-in-RDL spot
Serious and Kids roll, now just one hurdle from a head-to-head title fight; Angry tops Inconsistent to move to 4th

Area becomes first to clinch a division this season, extending their unbeaten streak to 40 weeks (just 2 from RDL's 5th longest run ever); Ducks top Menace in 1001, making the race for 2nd wide open; Secrets and Mafia post important wins
Shorthanded Rally narrowly escapes McGavin; Knights roll past Bandits, likely clinching their top-two finish; Bullies sweep all doubles from Stumble to climb out of the cellar
What's the Point drops a statement win on Blanks, taking all 12 '01 pts; Off Constantly gets big 501 sweep in effort to avoid a bottom-two slot, likely ending Dartness's shot at 2nd
Down To F gets critical win over Cheapies; Death Throw falls in 1001 to Two Time to fall a match off the pace; Nein Mark escapes the Shooters in 1001 to keep hold of #4 spot
Machine's 5th straight win yanks We Throw It from G lead; Rippin and Banging both win, move into the #1/#2 slots
Let's goooooo!!! Calm Under Pressure's first ever RDL win comes over Double Vision, who was undefeated just two weeks ago; Sofa now within a single win of clinching H title
